meta.subject: Fix inferred latch of VGPR address in LSU opcode decoder. Just use wildcard for sensitivity list in decode flag generator.

en.summary: This commit fixes an LSU decode correctness bug by restoring a missing combinational default for a VGPR source address, preventing stale vector register indices from being carried across opcodes.
why_it_counts: It changes central LSU/decode RTL, not tests or software.
The patch removes a real inferred-latch condition on an operand-address signal.
A stale decoded VGPR address can directly corrupt LSU operand selection.
disqualifiers: The sensitivity-list cleanup in flag_generator.v is secondary to the main LSU fix.
evidence: The commit message explicitly says the LSU opcode decoder had an inferred latch.
src/verilog/rtl/lsu/lsu_opcode_decoder.v adds a default assignment for vgpr_source1_addr_reg inside always@(*).
Before the fix, other combinational outputs had defaults but vgpr_source1_addr_reg did not.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: An instruction decoder for memory operations must drive every source-address output on every combinational path. If one vector-source address is left without a default assignment, the decoder effectively retains the previous instruction's address when a later opcode does not overwrite that field. The LSU can then read the wrong vector register even though the current opcode does not request that old address.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A sequence executes an opcode that writes a vector source address, followed by an LSU decode path that leaves that same address output untouched.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Let one decoded vector source-address output retain its previous value instead of forcing a fresh default each decode cycle.
portability_notes: Apply this to the decode block that derives LSU or memory-pipeline source register indices.
Any RTL or generated logic with case-based decode and per-signal defaults is a suitable target.
The bug is portable even if the destination signal name or register-file structure differs.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the combinational decode block that assigns LSU operand read enables and source register indices.
Choose one vector-source address output that is not assigned in every opcode arm.
Remove or comment out its block-level default assignment while leaving downstream read logic unchanged.
Preserve at least one opcode arm that assigns the signal and at least one arm that does not, so stale state can propagate across instructions.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: LSU opcode decoder combinational defaults for VGPR source addressing
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds a missing default assignment to vgpr_source1_addr_reg in the LSU opcode decoder and separately widens a decode helper to always @(*).
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Delete the vgpr_source1_addr_reg default assignment near the top of the always@(*) block in src/verilog/rtl/lsu/lsu_opcode_decoder.v. Reverting flag_generator.v is optional and not the primary fault.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The LSU reads a stale vector register index from a previous opcode, which can produce incorrect memory addresses, incorrect store data selection, or other wrong memory behavior.
evidence_for_injection: The changed signal is a decoded source-address register, not a debug or test signal.
The patch adds exactly one missing default in a combinational always block that already initializes neighboring outputs.
The commit message and code both point to a retained-value latch bug rather than a modeling-only cleanup.
notes: The core injectable bug is the missing default on vgpr_source1_addr_reg.
This is a straightforward reverse patch and does not require modifying the rest of the LSU pipeline.

zh.summary: 该提交通过补上 VGPR 源地址的组合默认赋值，修复了 LSU 解码中的真实正确性问题，避免不同 opcode 之间沿用旧的向量寄存器索引。
why_it_counts: 它修改的是核心 LSU/decode RTL，而不是测试或软件。
补丁消除了操作数地址信号上的真实推断锁存条件。
陈旧的 VGPR 地址会直接破坏 LSU 的操作数选择。
disqualifiers: flag_generator.v 中的敏感列表修改只是次要清理，不是主要故障点。
evidence: 提交信息明确说明 LSU opcode decoder 存在 inferred latch。
src/verilog/rtl/lsu/lsu_opcode_decoder.v 在 always@(*) 内新增了 vgpr_source1_addr_reg 的默认赋值。
修复前该组合块已经为相邻输出提供默认值，但 vgpr_source1_addr_reg 缺失。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 面向访存操作的指令解码器必须在每条组合路径上驱动所有源地址输出。如果某个向量源地址没有默认赋值，那么当后续 opcode 不再覆盖该字段时，解码器就会保留上一条指令的地址。这样 LSU 即使执行的是当前 opcode，也可能错误读取上一条指令留下的向量寄存器索引。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 组合式操作数地址解码默认值
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 先执行一个会写入某个向量源地址的 opcode，随后进入一个不会重新赋值该地址输出的 LSU 解码路径。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让一个解码得到的向量源地址输出保留旧值，而不是在每个解码周期强制给出新的默认值。
portability_notes: 应定位到负责生成 LSU 或访存流水源寄存器索引的解码块。
任何采用 case 分支并在块首集中设置默认值的 RTL 或生成逻辑都可映射此类故障。
即使目标 DUT 的信号名或寄存器文件结构不同，这个故障机理仍然成立。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到生成 LSU 操作数读使能和源寄存器索引的组合解码块。
选择一个并非在每个 opcode 分支里都被赋值的向量源地址输出。
删除或注释掉该信号在组合块顶部的默认赋值，保持下游读逻辑不变。
确保至少有一个 opcode 分支会赋值该信号，且至少有一个分支不会赋值，这样旧值才能跨指令传播。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: LSU opcode decoder 中 VGPR 源地址的组合默认值逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 LSU opcode decoder 中为 vgpr_source1_addr_reg 补上了缺失的默认赋值，并顺带把一个 decode 辅助块改成 always @(*).
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 src/verilog/rtl/lsu/lsu_opcode_decoder.v 的 always@(*) 块顶部对 vgpr_source1_addr_reg 的默认赋值。是否回退 flag_generator.v 不是主要注入点。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: LSU 会沿用前一条 opcode 的旧向量寄存器索引，导致访存地址、store 数据选择或其他访存行为错误。
evidence_for_injection: 被修改的是解码后的源地址寄存器，而不是调试或测试信号。
补丁只是在一个已有大量默认初始化的组合块中补上单个缺失默认值。
提交信息和代码都表明这是保留旧值的 latch bug，而不是单纯建模清理。
notes: 核心可注入故障点是 vgpr_source1_addr_reg 的缺失默认值。
该故障可以通过简单逆向补丁重新引入，无需改动 LSU 其余流水逻辑。
